feed.title: Dom Colligan
feed.subtitle: Write-ups on RL environments, graders and evals.

entry.title: Measuring what Matters: a review
entry.summary: A review of Bean et al.'s construct validity checklist, built from 445 LLM benchmarks. I ran all 28 items on GDPval and it came out 11 pass, 9 partial, 4 fail.

entry.title: ECBD: a review
entry.summary: A review of ECBD, a framework for constructing benchmarks taken from educational testing. I used it to formalise a benchmark on professional work, which aids rigor and interpretability in benchmark construction, however it is pre-agentic and domain agnostic therefore it needs to be adapted case-by-case.

entry.title: GDPval: a review
entry.summary: A review of OpenAI's GDPval. The task creation is strong, but the grader is flawed and the analysis could be extended. Tracing the gold taskset on HuggingFace turned up 4 bugs in 15 tasks.

entry.title: Suitesmith: environment + training run
entry.summary: An RL environment which trains a model to write test suites for functions which operate on structured data. 20 steps of GRPO took a 4B from 0.41 to 0.88.
